neighbours.label: a word-initial 'st'/'ch' fragment that starts a word the tokenizer splits (st|ings, st|oned, ch|asm)
fire: The criticism still stings, years after the review appeared.
According to the legend, the prophet was stoned by the crowd.
Unless the film is a real stinker, I usually enjoy it.
The quarrel opened a deep chasm between the two brothers.
His strident tone annoyed most of the committee.
The cheese had a strong, stinky smell after a week.
There is a wide chasm between rich and poor in the city.
The wasp stung her twice on the arm.
quiet: The criticism still hurts, years after the review appeared.
According to the legend, the prophet was killed by the crowd.
Unless the film is really terrible, I usually enjoy it.
The quarrel opened a deep gap between the two brothers.
His loud tone annoyed most of the committee.
The cheese had a strong, sour smell after a week.
There is a wide gap between rich and poor in the city.
The wasp bit her twice on the arm.
